evidenceSnippets: State University is the place to make it happen. It all starts with the FREE* application process. To be considered for admission, submit these two items: Application for Undergraduate Admission . Submit your FREE* application using the Wright State University application or the Common Application. Official high school transcript Partial transcript due at time of application. Final transcript, with graduation date posted, due upon completion of your senior year. Application materials should be submitted to: Wright State University Office of Undergraduate Admissions 3640 Colonel Glenn Hwy. Dayton, OH 45435-0001 Note: High school students who have earned credit for college courses through Ohio’s College Credit Plus, Advanced Placement, International Baccalaureate, or a dual enrollment program, must submit official transcripts after the completion of these courses. High school students do not need to submit college transcripts for Wright State to make an admission decision. Important Dates and Deadlines Ap
